body: The smell of ozone is sharp and alive, like a buzzing insect. I feel an inexplicable pull towards it, as if drawn by an unseen force. As I move closer, the air around me seems to vibrate with an electric energy. I can feel the tension in the air, the anticipation of something waiting to be revealed.
